entities.summary: Tofig Huseynov (b. 1954-04-19, Khojaly) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Khojaly and Azerbaijan. Known in the fields of azerbaijan, military leaders & commanders, asia.
